# kcore_waf_policy (Resource)

WAF policy (kind: WafPolicy): OWASP Core Rule Set through Coraza. engine starts as detect, which only logs. Destroy fails while a gateway or route still uses the policy, so reference kcore_waf_policy.<name>.name from their specs.

See the gateway page for a complete example.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Policy name (`metadata.name`).
- `spec` (String) The `spec` of a WafPolicy as JSON: `engine`, `crs`, `requestBodyLimitBytes`, and so on. `{}` is a valid policy with every default.

### Read-Only

- `generation` (Number)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
